name: yon-lang
description: One extension for Yon: diagnostics (compiler errors + linter warnings), formatting, hover, symbols, completion, and syntax highlighting, all from the yon-lsp language server.

yon.lspPath.description: The yon-lsp binary: a name found on PATH, or an absolute path. Build it with `cd frontend && dune build` (the wrapper is toolchain/yon-lsp).

yon.lint.enable.description: Show linter warnings (Wxxxx codes) as diagnostics, alongside compiler errors.

yon.format.enable.description: Provide Format Document via the language server (yon-fmt). Pair with editor.formatOnSave for format-on-save.

yon.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the Yon language server (for debugging).
